title: Oily Spicy French Cheese Gratin
description: A spicy, cheesy French dish from Brittany featuring whole milk and score-fat, ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients. It is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, combine the whole milk, shredded gruyere cheese, and melted butter.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and stir until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Add the all purpose flour to the saucepan and stir until the mixture is thickened.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with the cubed french bread.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is bubbly.
Remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the gratin hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze the gratin for later use.
Reheat the gratin in the oven or microwave until hot and bubbly.
